tools.name: get_current_spotlight
tools.description: Read the currently displayed settled public Spotlight, including labeled house advertisements. Does not bid or pay.

tools.name: list_spotlights
tools.description: Browse settled public Spotlights, newest first, including labeled house advertisements. Removed ads are excluded.

tools.name: get_spotlight
tools.description: Read one settled public Spotlight by date, including labeled house advertisements. Removed or missing days are unavailable.

tools.name: create_sandbox_job
tools.description: Start a synthetic asynchronous sandbox job that exercises the Idempotency-Key and 202-then-poll pattern of the write API without touching real auctions, ads or money. Poll it with get_sandbox_job.

tools.name: get_sandbox_job
tools.description: Read the status and synthetic result of a sandbox job created with create_sandbox_job. Every well-formed jobId resolves as completed, so a result is not proof that the key was created.
